baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive verb at 2, its cognate accusative at 6, directional ila, and fire at 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Verb-masdar repetition turns arrival into a force event: the subjects do not approach under their own power but undergo reiterated rough propulsion toward burning fire.

activation_trace.role: Rough thrusting supplies the literal force and governs the clause's transport mechanism.
Burning fire supplies the terminal medium while retaining the branch's branding potential.
A severe event-day makes the time noun the occurrence of coercion, not a neutral date.

changed_reading.before: On a day they are taken to Hellfire.
changed_reading.after: The day is itself a one-way force event in which they are harshly propelled into a burning destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Repeated د ع ع at 2 and 6 acts on a passive plural directed into the fire at 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel-agitation branch makes the destination a receiving volume and the plural subjects contents repeatedly moved so that the receptacle takes in more and becomes packed.

activation_trace.role: Agitating a vessel until it fills supplies the compacting material operation.
Burning fire supplies the substance and boundary of the receiving destination.

changed_reading.before: A crowd is pushed toward fire.
changed_reading.after: The crowd is handled as material contents, agitated and packed into a fiery receptacle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled د ع ع expression at 2 and 6 is passive and goal-directed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant root contributes a herding cry and rough drive, while the packet's non-dominant mapped root contributes a call that draws near; vocal command and bodily force coexist.

activation_trace.role: A chiding herding call supplies the audible social means of directing a collective.
Calling so as to draw near supplies an exploratory summons inside the directional motion.
Rough thrusting prevents the vocal model from softening into a voluntary invitation.

changed_reading.after: They are driven like a herd by a chiding summons whose voice and force make them approach what they resist.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Force at 2 and 6 is directed specifically toward نار at 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of the fire root carries aversion, flight, and instability. The clause therefore holds opposed vectors together: bodily recoil from the destination and force overriding that recoil.

activation_trace.role: Aversion and flight supply the destination's recoil vector rather than another sense of combustion.
Rough thrusting supplies the stronger countervector that defeats recoil.

changed_reading.before: The subjects move toward a feared destination.
changed_reading.after: The clause stages forced convergence against the body's own impulse to shy, flee, and refuse stability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The preposition marks orientation toward نار at 4 while the passive thrust occupies 2 and 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fire can be sighted from afar and function as a beacon or boundary marker. The destination is therefore not merely reached; it can stand visibly ahead and organize the forced route.

activation_trace.role: Sighting or seeking fire from afar supplies advance visibility along the route.
A beacon or boundary marker makes the fire a spatial organizer and terminal sign.
Rough thrusting turns orientation toward the visible sign into compelled approach.

changed_reading.before: The fire is an unseen endpoint named after the motion.
changed_reading.after: The fire stands ahead as an already visible terminal beacon toward which the subjects are forcibly routed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier denial of any repelling force supplies the missing counterforce for the focus clause. Rough thrust toward the fire becomes an unopposed vector rather than merely emphatic handling.

activation_trace.role: Rough thrusting supplies the positive force toward the destination.
Repelling an unwanted thing supplies the countervector explicitly declared absent.

structural_cues: 52:7-8 says the punishment will fall and has no dafi, while 52:13 gives passive motion toward its fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rough thrust and the absence of repulsion; I infer a one-way force diagram. A live alternative is that dafi negates punishment generally, not a literal counterpush on bodies.

changed_reading.before: The subjects are pushed hard toward fire.
changed_reading.after: They enter a force field with no available counterthrust, deflection, or escape vector.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea's branch inventory holds filling and kindling together. Joined to the focus branch of shaking a vessel until packed, it makes fiery filling and fire-making two sides of one receiving operation.

activation_trace.role: Vessel agitation until full supplies the operation applied to the passive plural.
Burning fire supplies the destination's active material state.
Filling with water supplies the context's receptacle state and activates the packing model.
Kindling and stirring fire links the filled sea image to the focus fire without collapsing the two materials.

structural_cues: The oath names the sea as masjur before a passive plural is driven ila fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sajara's fill-kindle bifurcation and da'da'a's vessel packing; I transfer that material logic to the focus destination. The live alternative keeps masjur local to the sea and leaves Hell spatially unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The crowd is agitated into an already existing receptacle.
changed_reading.after: Their packing fills the fiery receptacle in the same conceptual operation by which its fire is stirred up.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oscillating sky, displaced mountains, and thrust people form a scale-changing transport sequence. The focus becomes the human phase of a world in which fluid, solid, and social bodies all lose self-positioning.

activation_trace.role: Rough driving supplies the human-scale displacement.
Oscillation and wave-like motion supply destabilized movement at the scale of the sky.
Displacement and removal supply the transport imposed on mountains.
An elevated solid mass supplies the normally fixed body whose movement makes the reversal legible.

structural_cues: 52:9, 52:10, and 52:13 each intensify motion with a verb plus cognate masdar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three motion branches and repeated syntax; I infer a fluid-solid-human transport sequence. The live alternative treats each cognate accusative as independent emphasis with no shared mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts individualized punitive handling.
changed_reading.after: Human bodies join sky and mountains as matter forcibly relocated when the world's fixed ordering gives way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The subjects first act within khawd, whose branches include entering water and stirring drink; in the next ayah they become passive contents under vessel-like agitation. Active discursive churning reverses into bodily churning.

activation_trace.role: Agitation for packing supplies the bodily-material consequence.
Entering into water supplies immersion beneath the idiomatic discourse scene.
Stirring drink supplies the active churning that returns as passive agitation.
Aimless play supplies the prior mode of agency whose control is then removed.

structural_cues: 52:12 places an active plural in khawd and play immediately before 52:13 changes them to a passive plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immersion, stirring, play, and vessel agitation; I infer a retributive agent-patient reversal. The live alternative leaves khawd wholly idiomatic and sees no material continuity.

changed_reading.before: They are packed into fire without a prior material role.
changed_reading.after: Those who actively churned within empty discourse become the contents churned and compacted by another force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination's light and confusion branches are separated by the following deictic identification, denial, magic accusation, and sight question. Arrival becomes coerced epistemic exposure as well as thermal contact.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the fire's capacity to expose rather than merely burn.
Confusing another supplies the live epistemic obstruction that exposure overturns.
The repeated burning fire supplies the object identified demonstratively after forced arrival.
Contradiction of truth supplies the prior epistemic posture now confronted by its object.
Diversion and deception supply the attempted recoding of what is being seen.
Vision by the eye supplies the explicit test of whether exposure is being acknowledged.

structural_cues: 52:14 says 'this fire' and recalls denial; 52:15 asks whether it is magic or whether they do not see.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire as illumination/confusion plus denial, magic, and sight; I infer forced deconfusion at the destination. A live alternative reads the questions only as taunt, with no epistemic function assigned to the fire.

changed_reading.before: They are routed toward a visible beacon.
changed_reading.after: They are forced into the evidence itself, where illumination makes continued misclassification materially impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next command names contact with fire and activates heating that kindles or straightens, while patience is trapped without an exit and resistance is made equal. The thrust loads subjects into a process, not only across a threshold.

activation_trace.role: Rough driving supplies loading into the process.
Burning fire supplies the process medium.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies sustained contact after arrival.
Kindling and straightening by fire supplies an exploratory transformative operation.
A severity with no exit supplies containment within the process.
Equality between two states makes endurance and non-endurance operationally equivalent.

structural_cues: 52:16 follows the push with 'enter/burn in it' and makes patience or non-patience equal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat contact, thermal straightening, no-exit severity, and equality; I infer a processing mechanism. The live alternative limits the straightening branch to other forms and reads the verse as arrival plus punishment only.

changed_reading.before: The thrust ends when the subjects reach fire.
changed_reading.after: The thrust feeds a contained heat-process in which resistance and surrender no longer alter the result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The saved speakers recall voluntarily calling a merciful addressee, while the focus subjects passively undergo a harsh, call-like drive. The split mapping preserves a summons polarity without replacing the dominant force sense.

activation_trace.role: A call that draws near supplies the focus's exploratory summons layer.
The herding cry keeps that summons coercive and collective.
Averting harm supplies the protected outcome on the voluntary-call side of the contrast.
Calling and drawing near supplies the active prayer movement that reverses the focus passive.
Mercy and tenderness supply the opposite destination relation produced by voluntary calling.

structural_cues: 52:27-28 joins protection from scorching punishment to 'we used to call Him'; 52:13 is third-person passive and goal-directed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split call/drive mapping, active prayer, protection, and mercy; I infer an antiphonal inversion. The live alternative treats the resemblance as mapping-level activation only, not a syntactic relation between scenes.

changed_reading.before: A chiding summons is simply another means of herding.
changed_reading.after: The hostile summons becomes the dark counterpart of voluntary prayer: calling toward mercy coexists with being made to answer a drive toward fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions about being controllers or possessing coercive authority, followed by the reversal of plotting, activate the focus passive as a social power reversal: would-be directors become directed material.

activation_trace.role: Rough driving supplies the force now read as imposed control.
A controlling, dominant overseer supplies the authority they are asked whether they possess.
Overpowering force supplies the coercive authority absent from their claim but present in their treatment.
Power and jurisdiction supply the institutional side of the force reversal.
Plotting and counterplotting supply the explicit reversal from active design to being acted upon.

structural_cues: The repeated am questions culminate in 'are they the controllers?', then active plotting returns as passive makidun; the focus also suppresses the driving agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies control, authority, counterplot, and passive reversals; I infer that the focus grammar enacts dispossession of agency. The live alternative keeps the later questions doctrinal and does not project them onto bodily motion.

changed_reading.before: Unspecified agents force the subjects toward fire.
changed_reading.after: The passive routing enacts a reversal of sovereignty: those who posture as controllers become controlled cargo.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense for intentional work, each person held as security, adhering liability, and a heavy burden recode rough transport as enforcement of attached obligation rather than arbitrary crowd violence.

activation_trace.role: Rough driving supplies execution of the liability.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the causal rule behind enforcement.
Intentional action supplies what the recompense answers.
Security held against a right supplies the legal image of the person under claim.
Adhering punishment supplies liability that does not detach from its bearer.
A load made heavy supplies the bodily burden under which compelled movement occurs.

structural_cues: 52:16 joins recompense to deeds, 52:21 makes each person a pledge for acquisition, and 52:40 pairs liability with being burdened.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, work, pledge, adhering debt, and weight; I infer an enforcement chain ending in the focus transport. The live alternative reads these as general accountability images without a specific transport mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus shows an undifferentiated crowd subjected to force.
changed_reading.after: Each forced trajectory reads as collection of a liability already attached to the person by action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their severe day is something they meet, with convergence and violent sound or stunning. This turns يوم in the focus from a timestamp into an encounter threshold that catches bodies and voices at once.

activation_trace.role: A severe occurrence supplies event density to the focus day.
A chiding cry supplies the audible edge of the forced encounter.
Their own severe event-day supplies the named object of meeting.
Two things arriving face-to-face supplies collision rather than mere chronological arrival.
A violent sound supplies an acoustic shock that answers the herding-cry branch.
Being stunned or dead supplies the bodily consequence at the encounter threshold.

structural_cues: 52:45 says they will meet their day and be struck; 52:46 repeats the day and removes aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event-day, face-to-face meeting, cry, and stunning sound; I infer a day-as-collision model. The live alternative takes sa'iq as death alone and leaves the focus acoustics unactivated.

changed_reading.before: Day simply locates the rough driving in time.
changed_reading.after: The day is an appointment that advances into them as they are driven into it, a collision marked by command and shock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the fire branch's branding detail into the surah's writing and marking language. It remains valid through نار at 4 and exact branch-backed context cues; downstream prose should call it an inscription analogy, not translate نار as a document.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نار at 4 names the terminal medium whose branch explicitly includes branding by fire.

activation_trace.role: Burning and branding supply a permanent mark as an exploratory result of arrival.
Ordered letters and a written object supply the broader inscription field.
A written aligned line supplies visible ordering of the inscription.
A distinguishing mark that guides recognition supplies the branding's legibility.

changed_reading.before: The fire consumes or hurts those driven into it.
changed_reading.after: The forced arrival may also brand the verdict onto bodies, turning hidden accountability into a legible mark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a formula normally addressed to a stumbler is read against stunning and rising elsewhere. It remains anchored in the focus's exact د ع ع inventory; downstream prose should present it as an inverted echo, never as the lexical meaning of يُدَعُّونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated د ع ع at 2 and 6 directly carries the branch of a cry telling a stumbler to rise.

activation_trace.role: The recuperative cry to a fallen person supplies the image that the focus coercion reverses.
Stunning or death supplies the fallen condition from which recovery would normally be imagined.
Bodily standing supplies the voluntary rising posture withheld from the focus subjects.

changed_reading.before: A cry to the fallen would restore standing and agency.
changed_reading.after: The focus darkly inverts that recovery image: the stunned are not restored to self-directed standing but propelled toward fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cloud mechanics are mapped onto a human crowd. It remains anchored in the focus vessel-agitation branch and branch-backed dragging and heaping cues; downstream prose should retain it only as a material analogy, not claim that the ayah calls people clouds.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive plural under repeated د ع ع at 2 and 6 can be construed as contents moved into a receiving destination.

activation_trace.role: Vessel agitation until packed supplies the crowd's materialized handling.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies matter broken into transportable units.
Dragging and extending a thing supplies lateral transport of the material mass.
Heaping one part above another supplies the packed terminal arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Individuals are driven as a crowd toward fire.
changed_reading.after: Agency drains from the crowd until it behaves like dragged, fragmented, and heaped material packed into place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a distant nominal branch for small dependents through the descendants scene. It remains directly anchored in the focus root and supported by following and attachment cues; downstream prose should render only a shadow of stripped autonomy, never gloss دَعّ as dependency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled focus root at 2 and 6 includes a branch naming small dependents or children.

activation_trace.role: Small dependents supply an odd social register of reduced autonomy within the driven collective.
Following behind supplies directed dependence on another's course.
Small scattered ذر supplies the descendants scene that activates the distant focus branch.
A follower catching and reaching what is ahead supplies attachment to an imposed trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The passive plural is simply an anonymous crowd.
changed_reading.after: A faint humiliating register appears in which the driven collective has lost adult self-direction and can only follow an imposed course.

strongest_changes: The negated dafi turns rough thrusting into an unopposed force vector.
The sea's fill-kindle bifurcation and khawd's stirring activate a packed-receptacle reversal.
Repeated motion masdars align driven bodies with the moving sky and mountains.
The split call root and 52:28 preserve a vocal prayer-summons inversion alongside physical force.
Deictic fire, sight, recompense, pledge, and debt make arrival both forced exposure and liability enforcement.
summary.what_was_special: No single sense absorbs the rest: rough propulsion, herding summons, vessel packing, recoil, visible beacon, epistemic exposure, social control, legal enforcement, branding, and anti-rising remain coexisting focus-anchored readings.
remaining_uncertainties: How much audible summons should be carried beside the dominant physical-force morphology.
Whether the vessel, cloud, branding, and dependent models are compositional readings or only productive analogical shadows.
How strongly the omitted passive agent should be connected to the later authority-reversal sequence.
